definition: I. [ עָשַׁת ] verb smooth or shiny (?), si vera lectio (compare עֶשֶׁת ); — only Qal Perfect 3 plural שָֽׁמְנוּ עָֽשְׁתוּ Jer 5:28 (figurative) they have grown fat, they are smooth (or shine , from fat); doubtful word, Thes conjecture עָֽשְׁרוּ have grown rich (compare ᵐ5 ᵑ6 ᵑ7 ), so Gie (but וַיַּעֲשִׁירוּ precedes, v Jer 5:27 ).
